chunks.title: Stai Retail
chunks.content:
# Stai Retail — 用自己的品牌卖酒店 (/products/retail)
适合有客人、有渠道，但没有技术团队的独立卖家：小型酒店销售、旅行博主、私域社群主理人。
不写代码，开一家你自己品牌的酒店预订站。私域里的每一次询价，都能变成一条直接下单的报价链接；价格由你定，客人留在你自己的店里。

## 核心功能
- **品牌店铺**: 选模板，设置首屏与轮播，挂上微信、WhatsApp、电话等联系方式；店铺以你的品牌和独立地址对外。
- **报价链接与收银台**: 一单一价：在聊天里发一条报价链接，客人打开后核对价格与入住信息即可下单。
- **商品智能导入**: 手上的 Excel 酒店清单直接导入：自动识别中文编码，按别名或 AI 对上列名，入库前可预览和修改。
- **资讯与社区**: 店内资讯（支持 RSS 自动更新）、社区帖子与评论、站内消息，给客人常回来的理由。
- **开店清单**: 品牌、商品、上线按清单逐项完成，每一步进度清楚可见。

## 边界说明
- 在线收款通道按市场逐步开通，签约前请确认你所在市场可用的支付方式。
- 不含引流与 SEO 代运营，客人来自你自己的渠道。
- 旅游线路类商品仍在建设中。

chunks.title: Stai Retail
chunks.content:
# Stai Retail — Sell hotels under your own brand (/products/retail)
For independent sellers with guests and a channel but no tech team: small hotel sellers, travel bloggers, community owners.
Open a hotel booking site under your own brand, no code required. Every enquiry in your private channels can become a quote link guests book from directly. You set the price, and the guests stay with your store.

## Key features
- **Branded storefront**: Pick a template, set the hero and carousel, add WeChat, WhatsApp or phone contacts. The store runs under your brand at its own address.
- **Quote links & checkout**: One order, one price: send a quote link in the chat; the guest opens it, checks price and stay details, and books.
- **Smart product import**: Import the Excel hotel list you already keep: Chinese encodings are detected, columns matched by alias or AI, and everything is previewed and editable before saving.
- **News & community**: In-store news (auto-updated via RSS), community posts and comments, and on-site messages give guests a reason to come back.
- **Launch checklist**: Brand, products and go-live as one checklist, with progress visible at every step.

## Scope notes
- Online payment channels open market by market; confirm what is available in your market before you sign.
- No traffic acquisition or SEO service: guests come from your own channels.
- Tour products are still being built.

chunks.title: Stai API
chunks.content:
# Stai API — 一次接入，全部上游 (/products/api)
适合规模已经需要系统对接的 B2B 企业：分销平台、TMC、批发商与大型旅行集团。
接一次，卖全部上游的酒店：同一次搜索里比出更低净价，用一套账户体系管好下游客户的价格、授信与结算；价格情报、链路诊断、收益策略按需加配。

## 核心功能
- **一次接入全部上游**: 全部上游在同一次搜索里报价，按净价选出最优；平台新增上游，你不用再对接一次。
- **下游客户分层管理**: 为每个下游客户和子账号分别设置价格规则、信用额度与权限，也可以白标给你的同业客户使用。
- **统一酒店目录**: 各家上游的酒店与房型映射到同一套目录，同一家酒店的报价放在一起比；匹配质量可用你的样本核验。
- **钱包与多币种结算**: 买方、卖方与多币种共用一本钱包账；授信、冻结与扣减逐笔可查。
- **先验证再签约**: 用你正在卖的酒店清单，在沙箱里对比覆盖、价格与确认速度，满意再上线。

## 技术接入
- **HTTP API 与 SDK**: HTTPS 上的 JSON 接口，附 OpenAPI 文档；官方 Go 与 Java SDK。
- **预订链路**: hotelList → hotelRates → checkAvail → book → 查询 / 取消；两段式确认，先核价再下单。
- **MCP**: AI Agent 通过 MCP 调用搜索、实时报价与两段式预订；可经本地网关、静态 key 或 OAuth 接入。
- **实体与权限**: 平台 → 租户 → 客户 → 客户账号四级实体，RBAC 与实体范围共同约束每个请求。
- **请求证据**: 每次报价带 traceId / sessionId，TraceSight 用它还原整条会话链路。

## 配套产品
- AI 分销接口 (/products/ai-distribution)
- AI 自动化 (/products/ai-automations)
- Lookout 价格情报 (/products/price-intelligence)
- TraceSight 链路诊断 (/products/tracesight)
- RevenuePilot 收益策略 (/products/revenuepilot)
- 私有化 AI 部署评估 (/products/deepseek-appliance)

## 边界说明
- 具体上游的可用性取决于你的凭证、配置与合作协议；上线前请按目标市场逐个验证。

chunks.title: Stai API
chunks.content:
# Stai API — One integration, every supplier (/products/api)
For B2B businesses at a scale that needs system integration: distribution platforms, TMCs, wholesalers and large travel groups.
Integrate once and sell hotels from every connected supplier. Compare net rates in a single search, run your downstream customers' pricing, credit and settlement in one account system, and add price intelligence, diagnostics and revenue strategy as you need them.

## Key features
- **Every supplier, one integration**: Every connected supplier quotes in the same search so you buy at the best net rate. When the platform adds a supplier, you do not integrate again.
- **Downstream customers in tiers**: Set pricing rules, credit limits and permissions per downstream customer and sub-account, and white-label it for your trade customers.
- **One hotel catalogue**: Hotels and room types from every supplier map to one catalogue, so offers for the same hotel sit side by side. Check match quality with your own samples.
- **Wallet & multi-currency settlement**: Buyers, sellers and currencies share one wallet ledger, with every authorization, freeze and deduction on record.
- **Verify before you sign**: Run the hotel list you sell today in a sandbox, compare coverage, price level and confirmation speed, then go live.

## Integration
- **HTTP API & SDKs**: JSON over HTTPS with OpenAPI documentation; official Go and Java SDKs.
- **Booking flow**: hotelList → hotelRates → checkAvail → book → query / cancel, with two-phase confirmation: re-check the rate, then book.
- **MCP**: AI agents call search, live rates and two-phase booking over MCP, through a local gateway, a static key or OAuth.
- **Entities & access**: Four entity levels (platform, tenant, customer, customer account), with RBAC and entity scope applied to every request.
- **Request evidence**: Every quote carries a traceId / sessionId that TraceSight uses to rebuild the session chain.

## Add-on products
- AI Distribution Interface (/products/ai-distribution)
- AI Automations (/products/ai-automations)
- Lookout Price Intelligence (/products/price-intelligence)
- TraceSight Diagnostics (/products/tracesight)
- RevenuePilot Revenue Strategy (/products/revenuepilot)
- Private AI Deployment Evaluation (/products/deepseek-appliance)

## Scope notes
- Which suppliers you can sell depends on your credentials, configuration and partner agreements; verify each one for your target markets before go-live.

chunks.title: Stai Counselor
chunks.content:
# Stai Counselor — 你的客户，你的佣金 (/products/counselor)
状态：早期访问，尚未作为生产服务销售。
适合独立旅行顾问：客户关系在你手里，但没有自己的酒店货源与履约团队。
你经营客户关系，货源、预订、确认单与对账交给 Stai。给客户发一条你的专属链接，客户自己确认订单，每一单都记在你名下。

## 核心功能
- **客户与行程**: 客户档案、往来记录、分阶段的行程与行程段、笔记和收藏酒店，集中在一处。
- **专属下单链接**: 每个客户一条专属链接，客户用邮箱验证码登录后自己确认订单；链接带签名归因，订单不会记错人。
- **佣金与对账单**: 按归因自动计算佣金，随时查看收益，每月出对账单。
- **确认单与业绩**: 订单确认单、订单导出与业绩统计。

## 边界说明
- 资金流尚未在生产开通：客户线上付款、供应商虚拟卡付款与佣金打款仍在建设中。
- 全流程已在测试环境跑通，真实供应商联调进行中。
- 顾问准入审核与公开行程分享在后续阶段上线。

chunks.title: Stai Counselor
chunks.content:
# Stai Counselor — Your clients, your commission (/products/counselor)
Status: early access, not yet sold as a production service.
For independent travel advisors who own the client relationship but not the hotel supply or the fulfilment team.
You run the client relationship; Stai handles supply, booking, confirmations and statements. Send a client your personal link, the client confirms the booking, and every order is attributed to you.

## Key features
- **Clients & trips**: Client profiles, activity history, staged trips and segments, notes and saved hotels, all in one place.
- **Personal booking links**: One personal link per client. The client signs in with an email code and confirms the booking; a signed attribution token keeps the order credited to you.
- **Commission & statements**: Commission calculated automatically from attribution, earnings visible at any time, statements every month.
- **Confirmations & performance**: Booking confirmations, order export and performance stats.

## Scope notes
- Money movement is not live in production yet: online client payment, virtual-card supplier payment and commission payouts are still being built.
- The full flow runs end to end in the test environment; testing against live suppliers is in progress.
- Advisor vetting and public itinerary sharing come in a later phase.

chunks.title: AI 分销接口
chunks.content:
# AI 分销接口 (ai-distribution)
产品线: Stai API
一次 MCP 集成，接完全部供应商
面向 AI Agent 时代的统一分销接口：标准 MCP 工具面覆盖搜索、实时报价与两段式确认预订；全部供应商连接器在同一个接口后面，报价自带证据信封，价格规则可配置。

## 核心价值
Agent 时代的新集成税是「每家供应商一个 MCP」。我们一次接入全部供应商，报价透明、规则可配、预订有确认边界。

## 技术亮点
- MCP streamable-http 托管端点 /mcp，多租户单端点，Bearer JWT 认证
- 三条接入路：hbcli mcp serve 本地网关 / 长空闲静态 key / OAuth 2.1 平台连接器
- 工具契约单一事实源：MCP 工具与 Agent Skill 同源渲染，防漂移
- 进程内直调分销内核：与现有 API/门户同一套服务与权限边界

chunks.title: AI Distribution Interface
chunks.content:
# AI Distribution Interface (ai-distribution)
Product line: Stai API
One MCP integration. Every supplier.
The unified distribution interface for the AI-agent era: a standard MCP tool surface covering search, live rates, and two-phase confirmed booking. Every supplier connector sits behind one interface, quotes that carry their own evidence envelope, and configurable pricing rules.

## Value proposition
The new integration tax of the agent era is one MCP per supplier. Integrate once for all of them — transparent quotes, configurable rules, and a hard confirmation boundary on bookings.

## Technical highlights
- Hosted /mcp endpoint over MCP streamable-http: multi-tenant, single endpoint, Bearer JWT auth
- Three onboarding paths: hbcli mcp serve local gateway / long-idle static key / OAuth 2.1 platform connectors
- One tool-contract source of truth: MCP tools and the Agent Skill render from the same contract with a drift guard
- In-process calls into the distribution core: same services and permission boundaries as the existing API and portal

chunks.title: Lookout 价格情报
chunks.content:
# Lookout 价格情报 (price-intelligence)
产品线: Stai API
洞悉市场，守护您的利润空间
Lookout 提供工业级的高并发价格情报抓取、时序存储与自动化比价服务，专为大规模 B2B 酒店分销设计。支持按计划运行比价与价格监控；报价竞争力须结合实际供应覆盖和市场价格评估。

## 核心价值
支持按计划运行比价与价格监控；报价竞争力须结合实际供应覆盖和市场价格评估。

- 智能速率限制学习与自适应退让算法
- 多维度价格异常检测与预警

chunks.title: Lookout Price Intelligence
chunks.content:
# Lookout Price Intelligence (price-intelligence)
Product line: Stai API
Know the market. Protect your margins.
Industrial-grade high-concurrency price intelligence crawling, time-series storage, and automated benchmarking. Purpose-built for large-scale B2B hotel distribution.

## Value proposition
Schedule rate comparisons and monitor market changes; validate coverage and rate competitiveness against your own inventory.

## Technical highlights
- TDengine time-series storage: time-series analysis of supplier rate facts
- Distributed crawler cluster: throughput validated against supplier budgets and deployment conditions
- Intelligent rate-limit learning with adaptive backoff
- Multi-dimensional price anomaly detection and alerting

chunks.title: RevenuePilot 收益策略
chunks.content:
# RevenuePilot 收益策略 (revenuepilot)
产品线: Stai API
像量化策略一样运营酒店分销收益
RevenuePilot 是面向酒店分销的 AI 收益策略引擎。当前链路已覆盖自然语言策略草稿、发布前模拟证据和受控保存确认，并沿着赚钱机会识别与收益 Agent 编排继续演进，帮助客户在转化率、利润率和供应稳定性之间做更快、更有证据的决策。

## 核心价值
把商业策略从“人工经验 + 静态规则”升级为“AI 生成 + 模拟证据 + 受控保存”，让客户更快验证赚钱策略，并控制误配风险。

## 技术亮点
- 收益策略意图识别与结构化草稿生成
- 支持新增策略与修改既有策略的差异化应用路径
- Simulation-before-enable：命中模拟、收益影响、证据绑定与审计上下文
- 与 HotelByte 加价、供应商条件、RBAC 和保存确认流程原生集成

## 套餐
- **RevenuePilot Strategy**: 收益策略配置与模拟 — 面向商业团队的策略配置层。支持加价、客群、市场、供应商条件等策略模板，以及命中预览和发布前模拟证据。
- **RevenuePilot Quant**: AI 策略生成与证据校验 — 用自然语言描述收益目标，AI 自动识别策略意图、补齐必要字段、生成可审核草稿，并要求通过模拟证据后才能启用保存。
- **RevenuePilot Agent**: 收益策略运营助手 — 收益 Agent 串联赚钱机会识别、策略建议、多轮澄清、模拟证据、保存确认和审计上下文；更深的治理能力通过扩展点接入。

chunks.title: RevenuePilot Revenue Strategy
chunks.content:
# RevenuePilot Revenue Strategy (revenuepilot)
Product line: Stai API
Operate hotel distribution revenue like a quantitative strategy desk.
RevenuePilot is an AI revenue strategy engine for hotel distribution. The current workflow covers natural-language strategy drafts, pre-publish simulation evidence, and governed save confirmation, while continuing toward profit-opportunity detection and revenue agent orchestration.

## Value proposition
Upgrade commercial strategy from manual instinct and static rules to AI generation, simulation evidence, and governed saves so customers validate profitable strategies faster while controlling risk.

## Technical highlights
- Revenue strategy intent recognition with structured draft generation
- Separate application paths for creating new strategies and modifying existing strategies
- Simulation-before-enable: hit simulation, revenue impact, evidence binding, and audit context
- Native integration with HotelByte markup, supplier conditions, RBAC, and save-confirmation flows

## Tiers
- **RevenuePilot Strategy**: Revenue strategy configuration and simulation — A strategy configuration layer for commercial teams. Includes templates for markup, segment, market, and supplier-condition strategies, plus match previews and pre-publish simulation evidence.
- **RevenuePilot Quant**: AI strategy generation and evidence gates — Describe revenue goals in natural language. AI recognizes strategy intent, fills required fields, generates reviewable drafts, and requires simulation evidence before enabled saves.
- **RevenuePilot Agent**: Revenue strategy operations assistant — The revenue agent connects profit-opportunity detection, strategy suggestions, multi-turn clarification, simulation evidence, save confirmation, and audit context; deeper governance can plug in through extension points.

chunks.title: Private AI Deployment Evaluation
chunks.content:
# Private AI Deployment Evaluation (deepseek-appliance)
Product line: Stai API
Validate models, hardware and governance in your environment
Evaluate models, hardware, data sources and access controls for on-premises AI in hotel distribution. Validate configuration and delivery in the target environment.

## Value proposition
Choose an on-premises AI approach using measured results in the target environment.

## Technical highlights
- Model and target-hardware compatibility testing
- Retrieval and permission checks on approved business data
- Network egress, logging and retention review
